items.prompt: Balance the combustion of ethane. In the margin, write the questions you asked yourself or the decisions you made as you went.

content.speaker: Margin note 1
content.text: Start with C because it’s only in one thing each side. 2 C so 2 CO<sub>2</sub>.

content.speaker: Margin note 3
content.text: O last like Miss said. 4 + 3 = 7 O on the right. Can’t do 3.5 O<sub>2</sub>??

content.speaker: Margin note 4
content.text: Stuck. Doubled everything → 2C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>6</sub> + 7O<sub>2</sub> → 4CO<sub>2</sub> + 6H<sub>2</sub>O. Counted again, all match.

placements.rationale: Notices that 3.5 molecules is impossible, says why it’s a problem, repairs it by doubling, and recounts. “Like Miss said” shows the strategy is borrowed from the modelling rather than yet their own, but the monitoring and repair are clearly the student’s.
